outcome: No blocking correctness finding in the declared narrow contract.

reproduce.requirement: Install this source or its corresponding wheel in the hash-locked CPU environment first.

test_results.count_relationship: The 30 independent tests are included in the 121 joint tests, which are included in the main suite; do not add these totals.
test_results.warning: PyTorch reported missing NumPy; these tensor-only tests do not use NumPy.

independent_equation_oracle.construction: Recreates the declared fixture equation, uses independent local randperm, explicit affine gradients, and a handwritten SGD momentum/weight-decay recurrence. Does not call the model, autograd, optimizer, trainer or shuffled-stream implementation as its oracle.
checked: committed index order and exactly one visit per sample per recovered epoch
independent_equation_oracle.interpretation: Tolerance-based independent numerical validation is distinct from exact same-runtime replay.

recovery_checks.every_safe_point_restore: Exact full snapshot digest equality after each next committed microbatch, separately from the equation comparison.
recovery_checks.fresh_process_state: Disk snapshot after seven committed batches, with a pending two-batch window and existing momentum; restored with independently known expected configuration under Python -I and an unrelated working directory.
recovery_checks.fresh_process_result: Exact final snapshot digest equals uninterrupted continuation; final numerical state also passes the independent equation oracle.

split_snapshot_controls.stale_stream: A stale stream paired with newer trainer progress is rejected even after the outer checksum is recomputed.
split_snapshot_controls.stale_model: An earlier-epoch model with the same within-epoch cursor, newer optimizer/pending state, and a recomputed checksum is structurally accepted but fails the independent equation comparison; final parameter deviation exceeds 1e-6.
split_snapshot_controls.interpretation: Checksums and structural checks are not signatures or proof of computational history. Numerically plausible edited state is not authenticated.

limitations: Single-owner, single-threaded CPU float64 affine fixture only; no arbitrary model or loader support.
Recovery discards the failed owner and reloads the last whole safe checkpoint; there is no in-memory rollback.
Discarded or unsaved computations may execute again; no exactly-once external effect or durable acknowledgement guarantee.
No guarantee for arbitrary asynchronous interruption at the final commit/return boundary.
Controlled exception and subsequent recovery tests are not process-kill or power-loss tests.
Trusted own checkpoint files only; weights_only and size limits are not a hostile-file security sandbox.
Exact replay is scoped to the tested fixed runtime, not cross-version or cross-device portability.
This focused review does not itself assert complete repository, wheel, container or remote CI success.
